notes.title: BIG UPDATE!!!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

In Todays big update we improved many aspects of the game. Here is the summary:
1) Added new AI robots. MUCH BETTER ONES! They are unbeatable on the hardest setting and also really fast to play.
They come with easy, medium, hard and random settings. When you choose random and you have 3 or 4 player game - the system will randomly choose the robot strength.
2)  Replaced dictionaries for French, German and Bulgarian. They are much better now and all invalid words were removed.
3) Multiple bugs were fixed, including rare crash/freeze.
4) Improved tutorrial
5) Improved console controls on Steam Deck and PC with controller. You can now shuffle your letters by holding right bumper and also retract all letters from board at once and you can reposition your rack tiles individually.
6) History panel has been optimized to show longer words

Have a happy playing!

notes.title: Tons of new stuff with this patch
notes.content:
In this patch you will enjoy:
[olist]
[*] Multiple bug fixes (multiple bugs are now fixed, including some crashes).
[*] Console improvements (the game is now fully controller compatible) most important of which is when you get back your last letter put - the game will restore the typing arrow on the last letter place + joker replacement is now possible with joystick
[*] Tutorial bug fixes
[/olist]

Cheers

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 release
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We are happy to announce that we uploaded new improved version of the Happy Words game.
In this version we fixed dozens of bugs. We optimized the game to run smoother and also added new full screen button.

We also improved the robots. They are now playing much better and not passing as often as before.

Thank you for your support! We are looking forward to get your feedback and further improve the game.
Cheers

notes.title: Added Steam Friends invite screen
notes.content:
In this update you can enjoy the Steam invite menu.
You can invite your Steam friends to play Happy Words and you can also see which friend is online for play.
The menu has full controller support and is Steam Deck verified (Great on Deck).

Cheers

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
-We have added full controller support. You can now enjoy the game on Steam Deck in its fullest.
Supported controllers are PS4, XBox, Nintendo Switch and Steam Controller.

Cheers

notes.title: Update Three: More bugs are fixed
notes.content:
In Today's update we have fixed the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Letter is stuck while dragging it and your turn ends. This is now fixed.
[*] Sometimes game is not ending when player plays all of his tiles and the tiles bag is empty. We have fixed that as well.
[*] Fixed crash when joker letter is swapped.
[*] Fixed non working "SKIP TURN ON SWAP" option in multiplayer games
[/list]

Cheers

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just released the first Happy Words update.
Here is the list of improvements:
[list][*] French accent improvements. All accent letters are removed
[*] Robot too much thinking is fixed for some languages
[*] Joker letter replacement bug fix
[*] Performance optimizations
[/list]

Thank you for your support.
We are going to continue improving the game. Let us know if you find any bugs 

Cheers
